cost.question: Is PIANO LouvorJA really free?
cost.answer: Yes! PIANO LouvorJA is 100% free and open-source. There are no subscriptions, ads, or data collection. All code is available on GitHub.

offline.question: Does it work without internet?
offline.answer: The desktop app works 100% offline after downloading media. The web version requires internet connection to function. The APK app also works without internet, as long as content is downloaded locally and devices are on the same network.

devices.question: Which devices can I use it on?
devices.answer: PIANO works on any device with a modern browser: desktop (Linux, macOS, Windows), tablets, and phones. For the best multi-screen projection experience, we recommend desktop.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: The desktop app stores data (hymns, liturgy, settings) locally on your device. The web version requires internet connection and does not store persistent data. When you submit the contact form, your information (name, email, message) is transmitted via Web3Forms so we can reply. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

privacy.question: How do you protect my privacy?
privacy.answer: PIANO LouvorJA complies with GDPR and LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law). The website uses no tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies — only a technical cookie to remember your preferred language. We do not sell or share data with third parties for marketing. See our Privacy Policy for more information.

support.question: How do I get support or report an issue?
support.answer: You can reach us through the contact form on the Contact page, or open an issue directly on our GitHub repository. For urgent issues during a service, see the troubleshooting FAQ entries below.

updates.question: How is the application updated?
updates.answer: PIANO LouvorJA is a web application. Updates are applied automatically when you reload the page. No manual download or installation is required. You always have the latest version.

troubleshooting.question: What if the application does not load or shows an error?
troubleshooting.answer: 1) Reload the page (Ctrl+F5 to clear cache). 2) Check your internet connection on first access. 3) Clear site data in your browser settings. 4) Try incognito mode to rule out conflicting extensions. 5) If the problem persists, report it via the contact form or GitHub with browser and device details.

contribute.question: How can I contribute to the project?
contribute.answer: The project is open-source and accepts contributions on GitHub. You can report bugs, suggest features, submit pull requests, or help translate to other languages.

privacy.title: Privacybeleid
privacy.metaDescription: Hoe PIANO LouvorJA uw persoonsgegevens behandelt in overeenstemming met de LGPD (Braziliaanse AVG).
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how PIANO LouvorJA handles personal data collected through this website. We are committed to protecting your privacy in compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13.709/2018).

data.title: 1. Data We Collect
body: 1.1 Data you provide
When you fill out the contact form, we collect:
Naam
Email address
Subject of the message
Message content
1.2 Technical data
Technical cookie piano_lang: stores only your language preference. Contains no personal identifier.
We do not use tracking, analytics, advertising, or profiling cookies.
1.3 Data sent by the apps

While open, the PIANO LouvorJA apps (desktop, mobile and web) send a status signal every 5 minutes with: an anonymous installation identifier (generated on the device, not linked to your account), platform, app version, operating system, language, time zone, and the district and church you entered.
From that signal's IP address we only derive the approximate city and state. The IP address is not stored.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose of Processing
body: Contact form data is used exclusively to:
Respond to your request
Provide technical support
Send requested communications
The apps' status signal tells us how many devices are in use, in which regions and versions, so we can prioritize fixes and improvements.
Legal basis: Art. 7, item IX of LGPD (legitimate interest and response to your initiative).

sharing.title: 3. Data Sharing
body: 3.1 Web3Forms
The contact form uses Web3Forms (USA) to process submissions. Data is transmitted to Web3Forms for forwarding to our email.
Sub-processor: Web3Forms
Country: United States
Purpose: Message forwarding
3.2 Hosting provider
The site is hosted on a cloud infrastructure provider that may log technical access data (IP, timestamp, user-agent).
3.3 We do NOT share data with
Advertising companies
Social networks
Data brokers
Third parties for marketing

international.title: 4. International Transfer
body: Contact form data is processed by Web3Forms in the United States. This international transfer is necessary to provide the form service and falls under the legal hypotheses of Art. 33 of LGPD.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights (Art. 18, LGPD)
body: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
Confirmation of processing existence
Access to data
Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data
Anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data
Data portability
Deletion of personal data
Information about sharing
How to exercise your rights
Stuur een e-mail naar privacidade{'@'}pianolouvorja.com.br met:
Full name
Description of the right you want to exercise
Registered email address
Response time: within 15 calendar days (Art. 19, LGPD).

security.title: 6. Security Measures
body: We adopt the following technical and organizational measures:
HTTPS/TLS encryption on all communications
No password storage (no login system)
Data minimization (we collect only what is necessary)
Technical cookies without personal identification
Restricted data access by the team

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
body: Contact form: Retained for as long as necessary to respond, then for up to 12 months for historical records, then deleted.
Access logs: Per the hosting provider's policy.
Local app data: Remains on your device until you remove it.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
body: We do not use third-party, analytics, or advertising cookies.

children.title: 9. Children and Minors
body: The app is not directed at children and does not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. The content (hymns, liturgy, Bible texts) is religious in nature and does not involve collecting sensitive data.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this Policy
body: We may update this Policy at any time. The latest version will always be available on this page, with the update date at the top. We recommend reviewing periodically.

dpo.title: 11. Data Protection Officer (DPO)
body: Overeenkomstig art. 41 van de LGPD kunnen vragen worden gestuurd naar privacidade{'@'}pianolouvorja.com.br.

anpd.title: 12. Data Protection Authority

conduct.title: Community Code of Conduct
conduct.metaDescription: Principles, moderation and appeals of the LouvorJA Community — grounded in the Adventist philosophy of music.
conduct.intro: The LouvorJA Community exists so members may create, share and celebrate piano worship content that glorifies God and edifies the church. This Code is grounded in the official principles of the Seventh-day Adventist Church, especially "A Seventh-day Adventist Philosophy of Music" (Annual Council, 2004), the 28 Fundamental Beliefs and the Church Manual.
conduct.purposeQuote: “So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.” — 1 Corinthians 10:31

celebrate.title: 1. What we celebrate
body: Content that glorifies God, pursues the noble and the best (Php 4:8), carries a genuine spiritual message, balance, authenticity and cultural diversity — musical style is not a ground for exclusion; content and message are. Respect among members: taste differences are no ground for conflict.

notAllowed.title: 2. What is not allowed
body: Doctrine: lyrics or message contrary to Scripture or the 28 Fundamental Beliefs.
Improper: content stirring lust, passion, despair, anger or hatred — offensive, sexualized, violent or profane.
Copyright: plagiarism or unauthorized use of protected works — hymns have rights holders.
Spam: advertising, self-promotion, content unrelated to worship.
Conduct: harassment, personal attacks, discrimination or persecution of other members.

moderation.title: 3. Moderation: reports and strikes
body: Core principle: hiding is not removing. Suspect content is first hidden from the showcase; definitive removal only after review.
First light report (spam/other): content marked "under review", stays visible, enters the Game Masters queue.
3 reports, or 1 severe report (doctrine, improper, copyright): automatically hidden with top priority.
Game Master review within 7 days: kept content returns with an explanation; removed content earns the author a strike with reason and guidance from this Code.

Strikes: 1st formal warning + content removed; 2nd 7-day publishing suspension; 3rd publishing ban (account keeps consumption access). Removal does not erase authorship or legitimately earned points. Every strike may be appealed to the devs; severe cases go to the team.

gameMasters.title: 4. Game Masters
body: Following Jethro’s model (Exodus 18), two to three members invited by the development team carry the review queue, warnings and guidance of new members. They apply this Code as written; changes go up to the devs. Severe cases go to the development team. Order of decision: protecting the community first; preserving the creator second.

transparency.title: 5. Transparency and appeals
body: This Code is public and visible inside the app in the Community section.
Every author knows what was removed, why (which Code item) and how to appeal.
Changes go through the development team + leadership, consulting the Game Masters.
No content is removed silently.

invitation.title: 6. An invitation
body: The Community is a place to serve. Publish with excellence, report with justice, review with mercy.
invitation.quote: “Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.” — Psalm 96:1

institucional.title: PIANO LouvorJA for your church
institucional.lede: A free, volunteer-built tool for worship: synchronized hymn lyrics for projection, backing tracks and sung versions, right in your church computer's browser.

s1.title: What is PIANO
s1.body: PIANO LouvorJA is a free, volunteer-driven fork of the LouvorJA project, focused on the worship service: synchronized hymn and song lyrics for projection, backing tracks and sung versions. Please note: the app does not play sheet music — "Piano" is simply the project's codename.

s2.title: How to use it in church
s2.body: It runs on the sanctuary computer, in the browser (Web App) or in the desktop app. Setup takes just a few minutes and requires no technical knowledge: visit the download page, choose your platform and follow the step-by-step guide in the documentation.

s3.title: How to share it in your field
s3.body: We have prepared a press kit ready to print and share with local elders and pastors. Help other congregations discover the tool: share the material at officers' meetings, in bulletins and in your field's communication groups.

s4.title: Institutional contact
s4.body: For partnerships, institutional questions and support for adopting the tool in your field, reach the team at app{'@'}pianolouvorja.com.br or through the contact page.
